## W5 - Appointment reminders (24h and 2h)
Every 15 minutes, for every ACTIVE clinic in the Agency Registry: finds Booked appointments that are due a reminder,
runs the send guard, and (once WhatsApp is connected) sends and ticks R24_Sent / R2_Sent.

**Today the send is a STUB.** "Send reminder (stub)" builds the message and sends nothing, and no sent flag is set,
so nothing is lost when WhatsApp goes live. Open an execution and look at that node's output to see what would be sent.

**Send guard** (n8n/snippets/send-guard.js): skips if already sent, patient opted out, quiet hours 21:00-08:00 IST.
**TEST_MODE** (clinic Settings row): sends go to TEST_PHONE instead of the patient. A missing TEST_MODE row counts as ON.

**Windows** (Config node): 24h reminder when the appointment is 20-24 hours away; 2h reminder when it is 45-120 minutes away.

**Set up once:** pick the *Grist API* credential in every Grist (HTTP Request) node, set registry_doc_id in Config
(grist_base_url has no trailing slash),
then Activate. Needs the W11 error workflow set under Settings > Error workflow.
**When WhatsApp is ready:** replace "Send reminder (stub)" with the real send (output sent: true on success).
